_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-01 (FaceURL in data/tts/donatello.json). CardID = 17600 + idx: the same range as Medusa and the other TMNT decks, so the CardID does not identify the deck, its image does. The character card is 364 (sheet 3, 10x7, idx 64).

The real card wins over unmatched-memory: Shift focus says 'other fighters' (not 'oothe'); Self defense grid says 'discard pile' (not 'descard'); the three inventions carry a purple INVENTION BONUS band at the bottom of the card (memory renders it as 'PERMANENT.'); the hero card says 'After you play an invention, tuck it under this card.' and nothing else about the bonus.

Fighter restrictions from the banner of each card (unmatched-memory has none): DONATELLO 14 cards, METALHEAD 5 (Untested enhancements x3, The future of Ninjutsu x2), ANY 11 (Turtle power! x2, Thinking ahead x3, Short circuit x3, Quick strike x3).
Inventions (tag `invention`): Electro grenade, Self defense grid, Smoke bomb. Their bonus lives in data/heroes/effects/donatello.json (`invention`); the tag only lets tools and the AI find them.
Metalhead: 1 token (Custom_Token 428d15 in the save), melee, 7 life, MOVE 2. Donatello is a miniature (4fdf31); the life dials are ca8e35 (14) and edd0a5 (7).
